task.title: 处理 CIS manual-review 项
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：处理 CIS manual-review 项. Find CIS recommendations requiring manual review and decide whether to configure, document, or leave them for external verification.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：处理 CIS manual-review 项. Open All Settings Review mode for a profile that includes a CIS layer or CIS-derived source metadata.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：处理 CIS manual-review 项. Some CIS recommendations cannot be fully automated by BPM. Review mode surfaces those items so the user can make an explicit decision without claiming certification.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：处理 CIS manual-review 项. Open Review mode and filter for CIS manual-review items if needed.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：处理 CIS manual-review 项. Read the recommendation identifiers, affected policy or preference, and current value.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：处理 CIS manual-review 项. Configure a supported value, document why manual verification remains, or leave the item intentionally unresolved.

info.p: 预期结果：操作在 All Settings 中完成，并保留配置文件上下文。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 All Settings 场景：处理 CIS manual-review 项. Revalidate and record the decision before export or handoff.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查架构、值来源以及更改后果。

result.p: All Settings 显示配置文件的预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 CIS manual-review items are configured, documented, or intentionally left for external verification.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请清除筛选器、返回详细信息面板或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if the recommendation cannot be mapped to a visible setting, keep the item in review and consult the CIS guide when that guide is authored.
